name: wds_vtab-clevr_count_all
description: A vision benchmark derived from CLEVR focused on counting objects and related visual reasoning abilities. It measures a model's ability to answer count-based visual questions from synthetic scenes, stressing object recognition, grouping, and reasoning about quantities. Typically used to evaluate vision and vision–language models' counting and reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A niche component of VTAB-style CLIP/visual-benchmark suites used to probe counting/visual-reasoning; moderate adoption in vision-language evaluation.
